parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.tenants (slug, business_name, sector_code, market_code, currency_code, status, data_mode)
SELECT $1, $2, s.code, $4::text, CASE $4::text WHEN 'SA' THEN 'SAR' ELSE 'EGP' END, 'trial', 'real'
FROM public.sectors AS s
JOIN public.sector_packs AS p ON p.sector_code = s.code AND p.is_active = true
WHERE s.code = $3 AND s.is_active = true
RETURNING id, slug, sector_code, market_code, currency_code, status;

nodes.notes: DRAFT. Status is always 'trial' here. Admin approval is ONLY for going live with a real channel (admin-ops approve_live), never for trial. data_mode='real' and NO sample/demo rows are copied for a real owner — the tenant starts empty.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO owners (tenant_id, username, password_hash, display_name, phone, role, is_active) VALUES ('{{ $('Insert Tenant').first().json.id }}', 'owner', crypt('{{ $('Generate Temp Password').first().json.temp_password }}', gen_salt('bf')), '{{ $('Finalize Slug and Temp Password').first().json.business_name }}', '{{ $('Finalize Slug and Temp Password').first().json.whatsapp }}', 'owner', true) RETURNING id, tenant_id;

nodes.name: Ensure Services Catalog
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Services catalog rows are NOT seeded by 001_init.sql, so activation ensures them (idempotent) before toggling them. Adding a service later = one INSERT row here, never a new workflow.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO tenant_services (tenant_id, service_code, is_active, activated_at) SELECT '{{ $('Insert Tenant').first().json.id }}', code, true, now() FROM services WHERE code IN ('lead_capture', 'booking', 'orders', 'follow_up', 'digest') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, service_code) DO UPDATE SET is_active = true, activated_at = now();
